$comment: Qualification record (task P1.1, C07): the custodian's or launcher's record that a host configuration was qualified for a stage, for one plugin release and one authoritative agent_policy. A protected input: core.protected.guard reads it only from a file the running account neither owns nor can write or replace, and refuses protected use when it is malformed, not valid now, bound to another policy (canonical SHA-256 of the authoritative policy) or another plugin release (core.protected.identity), or revoked (revocation subject kind 'qualification'). The rules are written out in core.protected.guard.qualification_problem, which tests check against this schema. A qualification record authorizes nothing by itself.
